title: The Star Iron
text: A fallen star lies in a crater of glass, still warm, still faintly glowing, ticking as it cools. Its iron is the best there is, they say. The grass around the crater has grown strange, twisted, and the air hums.

options.label: Cut the fallen star. Iron like this comes once in a lifetime.

outcomes.text: Star iron, heavy as sin, and it scars every tool that touches it.

options.label: The wisest studies it first, to learn what it really is.

outcomes.text: It is not iron. It is something else, and it is worth more.

options.label: Leave it. Stars should not be cut.

outcomes.text: It hums as you go, softer, almost grateful.
